summary: Not a firmware itself: a catalog of FM-1 community firmwares found on GitHub, kept as pinned submodules, with automated builds for projects that publish no package of their own.
features: Catalog table and JSON data listing each firmware
Submodules follow each project's default-branch head
Nightly refresh; builds released with an index and SHA256 sums
Only builds licensed firmwares with a known build entry point
Builds are untested on hardware; keep a way back to official V15
